pick.name: Expo (React Native, New Architecture only) + Expo Router
pick.what: Managed React Native: native UI, OTA updates, EAS cloud builds, config plugins
pick.why: Shares TS/React/zod/API code with web+desktop; EAS builds iOS in the cloud from Windows; largest cross-platform JS ecosystem; on-device AI via react-native-executorch/llama.rn
pick.free_limits: Framework free. EAS Free: up to 15 Android + 15 iOS builds (low priority, 45-min timeout), Update 1,000 MAU, 60 CI min; Starter $19/mo
pick.windows_fit: native (Android emulator on AMD via Windows Hypervisor Platform; iOS via EAS cloud)

alts.name: Flutter
alts.what: Google's Dart UI toolkit (mobile, desktop, web)
alts.why: Best single-codebase performance and visual consistency; Codemagic gives 500 free macOS min/mo for iOS builds

alts.name: Capacitor (Ionic)
alts.what: Wrap the web app as Android/iOS apps with native plugins
alts.why: Fastest reuse of the existing React web UI

candidates.name: Expo / React Native (pick)
candidates.verdict: Best fit for TS one-stack + Windows-to-iOS path + agent familiarity.

candidates.name: Flutter
candidates.verdict: Wins for animation-heavy/pixel-perfect consumer UI or if desktop+mobile from one UI codebase matters more than React reuse.

candidates.name: Capacitor
candidates.verdict: Wins for form/content apps that are basically the SaaS in a shell; weaker native feel and on-device AI.

candidates.name: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose (native Android)
candidates.verdict: Best Android performance/APIs; Android-only, nothing shared with web;

candidates.name: Compose Multiplatform / KMP (1.12.2 stable)
candidates.verdict: iOS stable since 1.8 (2025); Kotlin-only, iOS builds need a Mac or macOS CI.

candidates.name: Lynx (ByteDance)
candidates.verdict: Proven inside TikTok; open-source ecosystem/app scaffolding (Sparkling) still young.

candidates.name: Valdi (Snap)
candidates.verdict: TS to native views, MIT, still beta (Nov 2025).

candidates.name: .NET MAUI 10
candidates.verdict: Weak adoption and bug reports; no React reuse.

candidates.name: Tauri 2 mobile
candidates.verdict: Web UI on mobile via Rust shell; younger than Capacitor.

decision: Expo wins on code reuse with the React web/desktop apps, the only turnkey iOS cloud-build path from Windows (EAS), and the most training data for Claude Code. Choose Flutter if the app is a standalone consumer product whose UI polish matters more than sharing code with the web SaaS; choose native Kotlin only for Android-only apps needing deep platform APIs.
details: Legacy architecture support ended in SDK 55; SDK 58 targets iOS 27 (UIKit scene lifecycle). Migration cost from the Kotlin app: full UI rewrite - keep existing Kotlin app until a rewrite is justified.

verify.note: Expo pricing confirms Free: 15 Android + 15 iOS builds, low priority, 45-min timeout, 1,000 Update MAU, up to 60 workflow minutes; Starter $19/mo with $45 build credit. Billing docs: free build limits reset monthly.
